author: Stephen Walsh
name: Clean Lambda Function Template
description: An AWS Lambda function on .NET 10, built with Clean Architecture minus the ceremony.

authorName.description: Who gets the credit in the Authors and Copyright of the Presentation project. Leave it and Stephen Walsh gets the credit, which he'd enjoy more than you would.

skipRestore.description: Don't restore packages after the solution is created. Handy on a plane, offline, or halfway through recording a podcast.

postActions.description: Restore the NuGet packages the solution needs, so the first build has less to do.

manualInstructions.text: Run 'dotnet restore'. It takes less time than a Better Know a Framework segment.
